## Valorant map win rates right now (Patch 13.10)

**TL;DR:** As of November 25, 2026, across millions of ranked matches, Breeze is the most attacker-sided map (52.5% attacker round win rate vs 47.5% on defense), while Ascent favors defenders (53.4% defender round win rate), according to valking.gg data.

- Most attacker-sided: Breeze (52.5% attacker round win rate)
- Most defender-sided: Ascent (53.4% defender round win rate)

Updated November 25, 2026 · Source: valking.gg global map data from millions of ranked matches.
